title: Add integrity column to media table in fieldwork::db
description:
Add 'integrity TEXT' column to the canonical media table in both Postgres and SQLite schemas. This stores the SRI hash (sha256-base64) for content-addressed media verification.

Schema change:
  media table: ADD COLUMN integrity TEXT (nullable, backwards-compatible)

Migration: ALTER TABLE media ADD COLUMN integrity TEXT;

This is a prerequisite for content-addressed media support.
